His limited athleticism and struggles in one-on-one defense could push him further down the rotation than expected at EuroLeague pace. Without a clearly defined role in Efes's deep wing rotation, his impact risks staying confined to limited minutes.

oyuncular.ozetDetay: Size'ı ve kulaç açıklığıyla çember koruması sağlayan, pick-and-roll'da dikey tehdit oluşturan gelişime açık atletik pivot. Switch savunmasındaki gelişimi, rolünün rotasyon oyuncusundan gerçek bir başlangıç pivotuna dönüşüp dönüşmeyeceğini belirleyecek.

How much he develops in switch defense will decide whether his role grows from rotation piece to genuine starting center.

Şutunu yüksek hacimde de istikrarlı tutabilirse, ikinci beşten çıkıp ilk beşte forma giyen bir kanada dönüşebilir.

His defensive versatility should make him an immediately reliable rotation piece in Baskonia's fast-paced system. If his shot holds up at higher volume, his role could grow from a bench piece into a genuine starting wing.

Paris's up-tempo system could be the right stage to showcase his biggest strength. The real question is how well he can mask his physical disadvantage defending the low post within the rotation.

The composure he showed winning the BCL title could make it easier to earn Šarūnas Jasikevičius's trust in big games.

Developing his decision-making and passing variety could elevate him from a straightforward scorer into the team's secondary creator.

oyuncular.ozetDetay: Atletik yapısı ve yüzü dönük hücum çeşitliliğiyle Fenerbahçe'nin pota altına farklı bir boyut katabilecek modern bir uzun. oyuncular.ozetDetayEn: Making the leap from Russia, a modern big whose athleticism and face-up scoring versatility could add a different dimension to Fenerbahçe's frontcourt. His athleticism could bring a level of mobility to Fenerbahçe's frontcourt that's rare at EuroLeague level. How well he holds up against physical bigs is the real question that will decide how far his role grows.

oyuncular.ratingNotuEn: A productive point guard who proved in EuroCup he can carry offensive responsibility. His shooting threat and pick-and-roll creativity can offer ready-made value to Barcelona's rotation; avoiding becoming a defensive liability and maintaining his decision-making will determine the size of his role.
oyuncular.ozetDetay: Pick-and-roll'da skor ve pas üretebilen, dış şuta ve çizgiye gitmeye yatkın dinamik bir skorer oyun kurucu. Barcelona'nın rotasyonuna hazır bir hücum katkısı sunuyor; EuroCup'ta gösterdiği üretkenlik, güven kazandıkça rolünün büyümesini mümkün kılabilir. Fiziksel boyut dezavantajı, EuroLeague seviyesinde savunma hedefi haline gelme riskini taşıyor.
oyuncular.ozetDetayEn: Bringing proven scoring instincts, a dynamic scoring point guard who can score and create in pick-and-roll, comfortable shooting from outside or getting to the line. He offers ready-made offensive value to Barcelona's rotation; the production he showed in EuroCup could translate into a growing role as trust builds. His physical size disadvantage, though, carries the risk of becoming a target on defense at EuroLeague level.

He brings the experience to share Milano's ball-handling load; the motivation of joining the very team that eliminated him could speed up his first-season adjustment. His height disadvantage on defense, though, could mean inconsistent minutes against EuroLeague's top-tier guards.

His limited athleticism and foot speed, though, could make him vulnerable defending fast-transition opponents.

oyuncular.ozetDetay: NBA'den gelen, çember çevresi bitirişleri ve yüksek motoruyla açık sahada etkili, fiziksel oynayan bir uzun. Valencia'nın uygun sistemi bir yana, asıl belirleyici olan NBA'de bulamadığı süreklilik ve güveni Avrupa'da yakalayıp yakalayamayacağı.
oyuncular.ozetDetayEn: An NBA-experienced big who plays a physical style, effective in the open floor through his finishing around the rim and high motor. Beyond fitting Valencia's system, the real question is whether he can finally find the consistent role and trust in Europe that eluded him in the NBA.

oyuncular.ozetDetayEn: A floor general product of the German development system, standing out for his court vision and playmaking IQ. A playmaker this young shouldn't be expected to find instant stability at EuroLeague level; given patient development, he could become one of the real breakouts of the coming years.

oyuncular.ozetDetayEn: Capable of creating his own shot, this NBA-experienced scoring guard shoots easily thanks to a high-level skill set. Defensive concentration lapses aside, the production he proved in the G League could make him a valuable weapon against switch-heavy defenses.

oyuncular.transferNotu: NBA'de Utah Jazz ve Minnesota Timberwolves formaları giydikten sonra sezon ortasında Zenit'e geçti; Avrupa'ya uyum sürecini orada tamamlamış olması, doğrudan büyük kulüplere geçen BJ Boston ve Jordan Nwora gibi oyuncuların yaşadığı adaptasyon sorunlarını yaşamasını engelleyebilir.
oyuncular.transferNotuEn: After stints with the Utah Jazz and Minnesota Timberwolves, he moved to Zenit mid-season; having already completed his European adjustment year there may spare him the transition struggles players like BJ Boston and Jordan Nwora faced jumping straight into a top club.

oyuncular.ozetDetay: Şut özelliğiyle öne çıkan ve üç sayı çizgisinin gerisinden yüksek isabet oranı yakalayan skorer bir kanat oyuncusu. Topsuz oyunda oluşturduğu tehdit, Fenerbahçe'nin top odaklı oyun kurucularının etrafında gerçek bir nefes alanı yaratabilir. Sezon başında sisteme alışma süreci beklenir, ama güven arttıkça rolünün büyümesi şaşırtıcı olmaz.
oyuncular.ozetDetayEn: Known for hitting at a high clip from beyond the arc, this NBA-tested sharpshooter is fresh off a season adjusting to Europe. The gravity he creates without the ball could open real breathing room around Fenerbahçe's ball-dominant playmakers. An early-season adjustment period should be expected, but his role growing as trust builds wouldn't be a surprise.
